methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $500K total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 13 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 20.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Photonium is a Pre-Seed stage semiconductor company founded by Jennifer Song and Adam Mhatre that has raised $500K to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor peers (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched.

Stage-Progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using total raised ($500K) as a proxy for pre-money valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. Peer-Median triangulation is not feasible; while 13 same-sector peers exist in the dataset, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies yielded fewer than 3 datapoints, making median calculation unreliable. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied without Photonium's disclosed revenue, which is standard for private-stage companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M to $1.44M, with a median point estimate of $1.25M. This range reflects sensitivity around the stage-progression multiplier but is constrained by a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable Pre-Seed peers with disclosed valuations and lack of revenue data to cross-check against public semiconductor multiples (median P/S: 20.4x). An updated valuation would benefit from revenue traction or additional founder-stage comparables.
